prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In After Adoption Selection: Move the sign-in step to occur after users have picked and customized their pet, letting them build emotional investment before creating an account. (why: Sign-in conversion drops 27.1% early on before users have chosen a pet, and sign-in takes a long mean time (567s). Deferring sign-in builds ownership first.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls Interactive Tutorial Screen: Add a dedicated visual guide screen right after home intro teaching users how to interact, drag, hide, and right-click their new desktop pet. (why: Support receives multiple complaints about users being confused on how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after onboarding completes.)
2: [choose_path, new_flow] Pet Quiz Discovery Pre-Flow: Add a quick 2-question pet style match quiz screen before path selection to help users choose between pre-made pets and custom generation. (why: Choose path has a massive mean completion time of 514s (median 8s), showing hesitation and decision paralysis.)
3: [home, redesign] Redesign Waiting Screen with Interactive Tips: Redesign the waiting screen to split view featuring progress indicators, estimated time remaining, and a tip carousel explaining desktop shortcuts. (why: The waiting screen (home step) takes a median 201s / mean 2336s, leading to drop-offs (81.3% conversion) and support questions about desktop features.)
4: [sign_in, copy] Account Persistence Warning on Sign In: Clarify sign-in copy to emphasize that pet progress and adoption certificates are permanently saved to the selected account. (why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again with a secondary account.)
5: [adoption, hint] Photo Quality Guidelines on Custom Pet Upload: Add photo selection guidelines and a live sample preview to photo upload screen to prevent custom generation failures. (why: 3 support emails reported that custom pet creation fails or looks wrong due to poor photo inputs.)
6: [home, wait_info] Background Preparation Notification Toggle: Enable desktop notification toggle and clear time estimate display while pet assets finish generating in background. (why: Waiting step takes up to 2336s mean time, causing users to close app prematurely (3 emails report app won't open or show pet).)
7: [adoption, layout] Grid Selection Layout for Pick Friend Screen: Change the layout of pick_friend screen to a visual grid featuring larger choice cards and pet personality sound snippets. (why: Adoption step has a high median time (89s) and low conversion (60.9%), indicating layout friction during selection.)

scores.note: Deferring sign-in builds ownership to address the 27.1% sign-in drop.
Addresses support complaints about controls and late drop-off at finish step.
Reduces decision paralysis on choose_path (514s mean time) with pre-flow quiz.
Keeps users engaged during long home waiting time (201s median / 2336s mean).
Cheap copy change addressing 8 support emails about account persistence.
Fixes custom pet upload failures reported in 3 support emails.
Prevents premature exit during background generation backed by support emails.
Targets adoption step (worst funnel step conversion at 60.9%) by reducing layout friction.
